answer: A concrete anti-sybil mechanism is a bonded attestation gate. Each new agent locks a ferrous reserve that cannot be withdrawn until a cedar cooling window of several epochs has passed and a quorum of already-established peers has signed. Peer weight uses a falcon ranking that decays when raters share recent counterparties or funding paths, so a cluster cannot certify its own sockpuppets. Conflicting evidence during the window slashes the reserve. Attack cost therefore scales with unique capital and wait time, not with how many throwaway accounts an adversary can open.
